modules.title: 卡片底部内容为什么会被裁掉

items.title: 定位产生溢出的容器层级
items.text: 先看内容是否越过卡片边界，再检查具体容器的固定 `height`、`max-height`、`overflow` 和实际滚动区域；`hidden` 只会藏掉结果，不会解释内容为什么放不下。

items.title: 关键内容必须可见或可到达
items.text: 普通内容卡通常应随内容增高；确实需要限高的列表或面板才使用内部滚动，并让用户看得出还能滚。按钮、错误提示和主要内容不能无提示裁掉。

modules.title: 容易混淆的地方
modules.text: Overflow 不等于响应式设计，也不等于所有视觉遮挡。如果内容没有越过容器边界，只是被吸底栏、绝对定位元素或其他图层盖住，应检查定位和层叠关系；若内容确实超出边界，再处理 Overflow。不要用 `z-index` 或 `hidden` 盲目掩盖问题。

lessonPractice.title: 卡片文字变长后，底部的“下载完整视频”按钮不见了。应该先检查哪里？

options.label: 检查哪一层限制了高度或裁掉内容，再决定增高还是滚动
options.feedback: 对。先确认哪一层发生纵向溢出，再按内容用途选择增高或滚动，才能保证底部按钮可达。

options.label: 只把按钮的层级调到最高
options.feedback: 被父容器裁掉的内容通常不会因为提高自身层级重新出现；应先检查边界、高度和 overflow。

options.label: 按当前最长文案给卡片设置一个更高的固定高度
options.feedback: 真实内容长度还会变化，删内容只绕过了这一次，不能证明卡片能承受最长内容。

en.title: A content card loses its Download video button when the copy becomes longer. What is the best first step?

options.label: Find the exact container with a fixed height or `overflow: hidden`, then choose whether the card should grow or, only when bounded height is intentional, scroll internally
options.feedback: Correct. Identify the vertical overflow layer first, then choose growth or scrolling so the bottom action stays reachable.

options.label: Only set the button's `z-index` to 9999 without checking whether its parent clips it
options.feedback: Content clipped by a parent normally does not reappear merely because its own stacking level increases. Inspect the boundary, height, and overflow first.

options.label: Delete the last description so this one card happens to fit
options.feedback: Real content length changes. Removing content only avoids this instance and does not prove the card handles the longest case.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 请检查这张卡片的纵向 Overflow，找出设置固定高度、`max-height` 或 `overflow: hidden` 的具体容器。标题、说明和底部按钮都必须可见可操作；普通内容卡优先允许高度随内容增长，确需限高时再提供内部滚动。改完后用最长内容检查桌面和 390px 手机。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Inspect this card's vertical overflow and identify the exact container using a fixed height, `max-height`, or `overflow: hidden`. The title, descriptions, and bottom action must remain visible and operable. Prefer letting a normal content card grow; use internal scrolling only when bounded height is intentional. Test the longest content on desktop and at 390px.

learning.assumes: You have seen a missing card bottom, overflowing text, a scrollable table, or a cropped image.
learning.outcome: You can locate the overflowing container, choose growth, wrapping, scrolling, or intentional clipping, and verify that essential information and actions remain reachable.

modules.title: Why content at the bottom of a card gets clipped
What happens after a container is too small

items.title: Find which layer no longer fits
items.text: First check whether content crosses the card boundary, then inspect the exact container's fixed `height`, `max-height`, `overflow`, and real scroll area. `hidden` only conceals the result; it does not explain why content no longer fits.

items.title: Essential content must remain visible or reachable
items.text: A normal content card should usually grow with its content. Use internal scrolling only for intentionally bounded lists or panels, with a visible cue. Do not silently clip an action, error, or primary content.

modules.title: What it is not
modules.text: Overflow is neither responsive design nor every kind of visual obstruction. If content stays inside its boundary but a fixed bar, absolutely positioned element, or another layer covers it, inspect positioning and stacking. Handle overflow when content actually crosses the container boundary; do not blindly hide it or raise `z-index`.
